method.timing: Sum of per-page medians after warmup, randomized backend order per repetition; archive decompression, file I/O and model/index work excluded.
method.selection: Same prioritized block, visibility, boilerplate and language rules; UTF-8 ignore decoding.
method.sampling: Up to 12 pages per source, mixing random pages with the largest pages in a sampled pool of up to 36; not the largest pages in each entire archive.
method.subjective_review: Source-based AI review of blinded variants before revealing backend labels: all two real-page disagreements, four random nonempty real pages, eight stress cases. Not a human user study or a prevalence estimate.
method.production_verification: Production Lexbor body/preview hashes match the measured prototype on all 250 pages; the preserved stdlib baseline also matches every recorded baseline hash.
method.memory: Single fresh process per backend, eight largest corpus inputs, body and preview extraction, all backends pre-imported. Additional post-exec VmHWM over the preloaded input/import baseline; not whole-application RSS.
limitations: Shared Linux x86-64 host; no CPU-affinity restriction or system-cache flushing.
